name: formosa-mcp
author: ycsmiley
description: Taiwan e-invoice lottery, TWSE/TPEx stock quotes and dividends, and rail timetables

localizations.name: formosa-mcp
localizations.description: 讓 AI agent 懂台灣：統一發票對獎、台股上市櫃盤後行情與除權息、台鐵高鐵時刻表

tools.name: invoice_get_winning_numbers
tools.description: 查詢統一發票中獎號碼與領獎期間。Get Taiwan invoice winning numbers; omit period for the latest draw.

tools.name: invoice_check
tools.description: 統一發票對獎；未指定期別時檢查最新一期與仍可領獎的前一期。Check a Taiwan invoice number; 3–7 digits only check sixth prizes.

tools.name: stock_quote
tools.description: 以股票代號或名稱查詢上市／上櫃盤後行情、本益比與殖利率，非即時。Taiwan TWSE/TPEx end-of-day quote by code or name, not real-time.

tools.name: stock_dividends
tools.description: 查詢上市／上櫃近期除權息日程，可指定股票代號或名稱。Upcoming Taiwan TWSE/TPEx ex-dividend and ex-right dates; optional code or name.
